children.name: nghttp2: nghttp2: Denial of Service via malformed HTTP/2 frames after session termination

1. Test Case ID: MFnqWS

- API rejected schema-compliant request

    Valid data should have been accepted
    Expected: 2xx, 401, 403, 404, 409, 5xx

[429] Too Many Requests:

    `Too many requests, please try again later.`

Reproduce with:

    curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"hex": "#51ea80", "name": "8p"}' http://127.0.0.1:5001/api/colors
